summary.text: John Harabedian represents California's 41st Assembly District, which includes Pasadena, Monrovia, Claremont, Sierra Madre and other cities.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Sierra Madre, he began his public service as a city councilmember in 2012, was re-elected in 2016 and served twice as mayor, according to his official biography.
He is an attorney who has served as a prosecutor in the Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office.
Harabedian holds a bachelor's degree from Yale University, a master's in comparative social policy from Oxford University and a law degree from Stanford University, and lives in Pasadena.
